column1: # The Symbulator timeline — the one source for both renderings.
# Two columns, tab-separated: the date as it should read, and the event.
# `py Documentation\tools\gen_timeline.py` writes this table into both
# books, between their TIMELINE:BEGIN / TIMELINE:END markers:
#   Documentation/src/99-credits.md      the Roll the credits chapter
# `--check` compares the two against this file and is run by
# `build.py --check`, so an edit here that is never regenerated fails the
# build rather than shipping two books that disagree.
# Roberto is the source. Do not add a provenance column and do not link
# documents from the table (his instruction, 16 Sep 2026).

column2: The first line of code, at the Technological University of Panama in Azuero.
Version 0.92, the first public release, goes onto the Internet.
Version 2, presented in person for the first time, at UTP Azuero.
The Elect SCS plug-in. The program is still called SCS.
The Power Tools plug-in. The program is now called Symbulator.
First place, IEEE Region 9 Student Paper Competition.
The paper is published in Panama, in the bulletin of the IEEE section.
The thesis is defended, and graded 100 out of 100.
The paper is published in Barcelona, in the magazine of the IEEE student branch.
The symbulator package goes onto PyPI.
